candidates.change_summary: Remove the require statement that checks for overflow on balance addition.
Change unlockTime assignment to always use the provided _unlockTime, ignoring block.timestamp.
Remove the update to acc.unlockTime, leaving the unlock time unchanged.
Remove the call to LogFile.AddMessage, so the log is not updated on Put.
Remove the unlock time check so funds can be collected before the unlock time.
Replace the subtraction with an addition, increasing the balance instead of decreasing it.
Remove the balance check so Collect can drain the contract even with insufficient personal balance.
Allow Collect only when the unlock time has NOT passed, reversing the temporal guard.
Do not update the user's balance after sending the funds, enabling double-spend.
Change the send address to the contract itself, burning the funds instead of sending to the caller.
Remove the entire if-condition so Collect always attempts to transfer funds regardless of balance or unlock time.
Change the MinSum check to require balance strictly greater than MinSum.
Remove the success check so a failed transfer does not revert the transaction but still burns the balance.
